verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a built-in Apollo Sandbox at api.fireflies.ai/graphql where you add your API key as a Bearer header and interactively explore and run queries against the schema via introspection. Per-operation reference pages and an examples section with runnable Replit snippets complement it. The missing OpenAPI spec is expected for a GraphQL API and does not undercut this. Missing for 10: no evidence of in-page "try it" consoles within the reference docs themselves, examples are only thinly described (one Replit mention), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
